description: N Qlik Cloud apps as Dagster assets from one component instance, with one shared observation sensor -- closes the scaling gap in the sibling single-app qlik_cloud_app_reload component (30 dashboards previously meant 30 component instances). Real Qlik Cloud REST API (verified against qlik.dev/apis/rest/reloads/), with a QlikCloudTransport seam (trigger_reload/get_reload/list_reloads) that tests swap for a fake instead of patching requests calls.

outputs.description: One materializable Dagster asset per declared Qlik Cloud app + one shared observation sensor (opt-in).

tenant_url_env_var.label: Tenant Url Env Var
tenant_url_env_var.description: Env var holding the tenant base URL, e.g. https://my-tenant.us.qlikcloud.com (Qlik Cloud is tenant-scoped -- there is no shared hostname).

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a Qlik Cloud API key (Bearer token -- see qlik.dev's 'generate your first API key').

apps.label: Apps
apps.description: Qlik Cloud apps to wrap as Dagster assets. Each item: {app_id, asset_key, description?, group_name?, deps?, partial?, owners?, tags?}.

assets_by_app.label: Assets By App
assets_by_app.description: Override the asset spec for specific apps by app_id. Mirrors the official dagster-databricks DatabricksWorkspaceComponent.assets_by_task_key shape.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for a reload to reach a terminal status before failing the run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for apps without their own group_name.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Catalog tags applied to every app asset (merged with each app's own tags).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Default asset owners for apps without their own.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: If true, adds ONE sensor (not one per app) that polls every declared app for reloads this component did NOT trigger, and emits AssetObservation for each one.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Sensor name. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between sensor polls. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

name: QlikCloudWorkspace
